long_biography.plain_text:
Crest Investment Company became Jamal Daniel's vehicle for a broad investment career. The Houston firm and related Daniel family trusts held significant positions in telecommunications and energy businesses. Crest exchanged wireless-spectrum assets for a Clearwire stake and remained a significant shareholder for years, combining private-asset development with public-company investment.

Daniel grew up in Syria and studied in Lebanon and Geneva before moving to the United States. He earned a business degree from Pepperdine University and an MBA from the University of Texas at Austin. Daniel later founded the Levant Foundation, Levantine Films and Al-Monitor, investing part of his capital in education, filmmaking and regional journalism. The Levant Foundation supports cultural and educational programmes focused on the region.
